description: Capabilities granted to the main webview. The SPA NEVER calls @tauri-apps/plugin-fs or plugin-shell directly — every filesystem / process action goes through the FastAPI sidecar (path-checked, audit-logged) or one of our custom IPC commands in src/commands.rs (pick_folder, open_external_url, …). We therefore deliberately do NOT grant fs:default or shell:default; those would let any XSS-injected script bypass our backend's permission checks and read or execute anything as the user.
